rule Suspicious_Outlook_Child_Process {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 or powershell launched directly from Outlook"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1566.001, T1218.011"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $parent_proc = "outlook.exe" fullword ascii
        $child_proc1 = "rundll32.exe" fullword ascii
        $child_proc2 = "powershell.exe" fullword ascii
    condition:
        running_in_foreground and
        process_parent_name matches $parent_proc and
        (process_name matches $child_proc1 or process_name matches $child_proc2)
}
